rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Two rooks give checkmate on their own, without help from the king. They climb like a ladder.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The rook on a4 closes the 4th rank: the black king cannot come down.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: The other rook gives check on the rank above. That way, the king has to climb higher.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Give the check that pushes the king up, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Check on the 5th rank. The king cannot stay on it or go down.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook on b1 goes up to b5 and gives check. The rook on a4 holds the rank below.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a4a5.1: It is check, but the 4th rank is now open.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a4a5.2: The king goes down through it, and the ladder starts over.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a4a5.3: Let's go back: the rook on a4 stays put, holding the 4th rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b1e1.1: It is check along the file, but it does not push the king up.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b1e1.2: The king just steps aside and stays on the 5th rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b1e1.3: Let's go back: the check comes along the rank above.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not give check on the rank above. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Give the check that pushes the king up, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The king climbs to the 6th rank. Now the rooks swap roles.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: The rook on a4 goes up to a6 and gives check. The one on b5 holds the 5th rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.l4: Check on the 7th rank. Only the last rank is left for the king.
rot.ideia.ex1.l6: Checkmate! The rook on b7 closes the 7th rank, and the one on a8 gives check.
rot.ideia.ex1.l7: Remember the idea: the lower rook moves ahead and gives check. The other holds the rank.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Sometimes the black king gets close to the rook that would give the next check.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: If the rook on h4 goes up to h6, the king captures it: h6 is right next to it.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: The rook on h4 goes to the other side of the rank, three files or more from the king, out of reach.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Take the rook on h4 far from the king, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! On b4, the rook is on the other side, far from the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The rook goes to b4, at the other end. From there, the king cannot reach it.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.h4c4.1: That works too! On c4, the rook is also far from the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.h4c4.2: Let's continue with the rook on b4, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.h4d4.1: That works too! On d4, the rook is also far from the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.h4d4.2: Let's continue with the rook on b4, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.h4h6.1: It is check, but the rook is right next to the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.h4h6.2: The king captures the rook. With only one, the mate takes much longer.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.h4h6.3: Let's go back: first, take the rook far from the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not take the rook to the other end. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Take the rook on h4 far from the king, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The king tries to get closer, but the rook is already far away.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now it works: check on the 6th rank, far from the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: The ladder goes on: check on the 7th rank.
rot.ideia.ex2.l7: Remember the idea: if the king gets close, take the rook to the other end. Then keep climbing.
rot.ideia.ex2.l8: Now I will show the ladder in another direction and how to start from scratch.
rot.demos.colunas.e1: The ladder works towards any edge. Here, the rook on e8 closes the e-file.
rot.demos.colunas.l1: The other rook gives check along the d-file.
rot.demos.colunas.l2: The king moves to the c-file.
rot.demos.colunas.l3: Check along the c-file. The rook on d1 holds the d-file.
rot.demos.colunas.l4: The king moves to the b-file.
rot.demos.colunas.l6: The king reaches the left edge.
rot.demos.colunas.l7: Checkmate! The rooks went file by file to the edge.
rot.demos.parede.e1: With both rooks at the bottom, the first move does not even need to be check.
rot.demos.parede.l1: The rook closes the 4th rank, like a wall: the king is stuck above it.
rot.demos.parede.l2: Then comes the ladder: the rook on b1 checks on the 5th rank, and they take turns to the edge.
rot.demos.parede.l3: Now it's your turn: in the next positions, you climb the ladder to mate.
rot.pratica.escada.enunciado: Give checkmate with the ladder: each move, the lower rook moves ahead and checks.
rot.pratica.escada.fim: Perfect. One rook holds, the other checks, all the way to the edge.
rot.pratica.escada.err.a3a4: It is check, but the 3rd rank is open, and the king comes down. Try again.
rot.pratica.longe.enunciado: Give checkmate. The king is near the rook on h1: take it to the other side, out of reach.
rot.pratica.longe.fim: Well done. Rook far from the king, then the ladder to mate.
rot.pratica.longe.err.h1h5: On h5, the rook is next to the king, and it captures it. Try again.
